headlines.title: 大行评级丨花旗：内房或将迎来升浪，首选华润置地、贝壳及中国金茂等
headlines.summary: 花旗发表研报指，对中国房地产行业维持正面看法，受惠于核心城市成交韧性及低基数效应推动，9月起发展商加强推售新盘，加上憧憬7月底举行的政治局会议将释放支持讯号，例如公积金购房及以旧换新等措施或进一步放宽，相信7月至9月行业销售增长有望回稳。该行认为内房行业已为8月至10月的升浪做好准备，将华润置地、建发国际、贝壳、中国金茂及中国海外发展视为首选股。

headlines.title_en: Major rating | Citigroup: China property sector may see rally; top picks CR Land, Beike, and China Jinmao
headlines.summary_en: Citi maintains a positive view on China's real estate sector, citing resilient core city sales and a low base effect. Developers are expected to ramp up new project launches from September, with hopes that the Politburo meeting in late July will signal support measures, such as easing provident fund home purchases and trade-in policies, stabilizing sales growth from July to September. The sector is set for an August-October rally, with top picks being CR Land, C&D International, Beike, China Jinmao, and China Overseas Land & Investment.

headlines.title: 上海：上半年社会融资规模增加6914亿元 上半年本外币贷款增加5315亿元
headlines.summary: 人民银行上海总部7月29日召开2026年第三季度新闻发布会，介绍今年上半年上海金融运行情况，并回答记者提问。上半年，全市社会融资规模增加6914亿元，较好满足了实体经济的融资需求。6月末，全市本外币贷款余额13.60万亿元，同比增长5.9%。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: H1 social financing increased by 691.4 billion yuan, H1 local and foreign currency loans up by 531.5 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: On July 29, the PBOC Shanghai Headquarters held a Q3 2026 press conference, reporting H1 Shanghai financial operations. H1 saw aggregate social financing increase by 691.4 billion yuan, meeting real economy financing needs. By end-June, local currency loans stood at 13.60 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》
headlines.summary: 《通知》协同推进科技金融领域数据开发利用，发布《全国科技金融领域数据开发利用目录1.0》，涵盖企业名单与科创属性、进出口、投融资、经营、研发投入、知识产权、创新能力评价、企业需求等8大类、26个数据指标。支持各地形成具有区域特色的科技金融数据开发利用清单，建设省级科技金融领域数据开发利用配套信息设施，加强现有信息系统资源互联互通，促进数据信息归集共享。坚持统筹发展与安全，规范科技公共数据开发利用，加强全过程安全管理，切实防范各种数据风险。

headlines.title_en: PBOC and eight other departments jointly issue notice on enhancing data development and utilization in tech finance
headlines.summary_en: The Notice promotes coordinated data development and utilization in sci-tech finance, releasing the 'National Sci-Tech Finance Data Development and Utilization Directory 1.0,' covering 8 categories and 26 data indicators, including enterprise lists, sci-tech attributes, imports/exports, investments and financing, operations, R&D spending, IP, innovation capability ratings, and enterprise needs. It supports regions in creating tailored sci-tech finance data development lists, building supporting information facilities, enhancing interconnectivity of existing systems, and promoting data collection and sharing. It emphasizes balancing development and security, standardizing sci-tech public data use, strengthening full-process security management, and preventing data risks.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:

headlines.title_en: ChiNext rebounds 1.55%, consumer stocks rally broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: The market recovered from a morning dip, with all three major indices rebounding. Most stocks rose, with over 4,200 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets gaining, and total turnover reaching 2.31 trillion yuan. The Shanghai Composite closed up 0.4%, the Shenzhen Component up 1.1%, and the ChiNext up 1.55%. 2, Sectors: Food, dairy, retail, and gaming led gains, while lithography, memory chips, advanced packaging, and glass substrates lagged. 3, Hot concepts: Consumer stocks such as food, dairy, and retail strengthened, with multiple stocks like Huanlejia, Liziyuan, and Dongbai Group hitting limit up. Gaming stocks rose, with Dianhun Network, Kaiying Network, and Giant Network hitting limit up. Auto stocks rebounded, with BAIC BluePark hitting limit up. Brokerage and financial stocks gained in the afternoon, with Hualin Securities hitting limit up. On the downside, lithography concept stocks adjusted, with Maorui Optical and Xinlai Materials falling over 10%.

headlines.title_en: Nine departments: pilot tech finance trusted data space innovation development; encourage qualified regions to enhance openness and use of enterprise cash flow data
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 29: The People's Bank of China and eight other departments jointly issued the 'Notice on Strengthening Data Development and Utilization in Sci-Tech Finance.' The Notice emphasizes enhancing open sharing and integrated use of sci-tech finance data, supporting sci-tech information users in standardizing the application of public data, encouraging local governments to provide authorized information channels for sci-tech enterprises, and promoting models like information inquiry and joint modeling. It launches innovative sci-tech finance trusted data space pilot projects, encourages eligible regions to strengthen open use of enterprise cash flow data, builds industry research information exchange platforms, and achieves cross-regional sharing and efficient matching of sci-tech finance data resources. It supports market-oriented credit agencies in building sci-tech enterprise databases, enriching credit product and service supply.

headlines.title: 九部门：引导金融机构依托科技金融领域数据库，打造特色的科技型企业风控投研模型
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月29日讯，中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。《通知》围绕完善数据赋能科技金融全链条，聚焦融资对接、智能风控、产品创新等环节，引导金融机构依托科技金融领域数据库，构建科技型企业数字信用画像，打造特色的科技型企业风控投研模型，开发契合细分行业企业融资需求的科技金融产品。鼓励金融机构与相关部门合作，运用交易集中度、交易对手分布、交易对手稳定性等数据，开展产业链资金流动分析，绘制重点产业链图谱，“一链一策”精准匹配金融资源。

headlines.title_en: Nine departments: guide financial institutions to leverage tech finance database, build specialized risk control and investment models for tech firms
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 29: The People's Bank of China and eight other departments jointly issued the 'Notice on Strengthening Data Development and Utilization in Sci-Tech Finance.' The Notice focuses on enhancing the entire chain of data empowering sci-tech finance, targeting financing matching, intelligent risk control, and product innovation, guiding financial institutions to build digital credit profiles for sci-tech enterprises using sci-tech finance databases, create tailored risk control and investment research models, and develop sci-tech finance products suited to financing needs of segmented industries. It encourages financial institutions to collaborate with relevant departments, using data such as transaction concentration, counterparty distribution, and counterparty stability to conduct industry chain cash flow analysis, map key industry chains, and precisely match financial resources with a one-chain-one-policy approach.

headlines.title: 瑞银CEO认为未来市场将继续出现波动性“飙升”
headlines.summary: 瑞银集团首席执行官Sergio Ermotti在接受采访时表示，他预计今年剩余时间里“波动性飙升”还将继续。“从宏观形势、地缘政治局势、当前的争论，以及我们在股市中看到的巨大分化来看，能源价格面临的压力可能会给通胀带来潜在的逆风”。Ermotti表示投资者不会喜欢这种波动，“我确实预计在今年剩余时间里波动性将继续飙升”。

headlines.title_en: UBS CEO expects 'spikes' in market volatility to continue
headlines.summary_en: UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti said in an interview that he expects 'volatility spikes' to continue for the rest of the year. 'From the macro situation, geopolitical tensions, current debates, and the massive divergence we're seeing in the stock market, pressures on energy prices could create potential headwinds for inflation.' Ermotti added that investors will not like this volatility, stating, 'I do expect volatility to continue spiking for the rest of the year.'

headlines.title_en: Beijing releases measures to reward expansion of cultural and tourism new consumption
headlines.summary_en: On July 29, the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism announced the formal release of the 'Beijing Measures for Rewarding the Expansion of New Cultural and Tourism Consumption,' aiming to further unlock consumption potential and leverage the guiding role of fiscal funds to promote deep integration of culture and tourism, supporting high-quality development of the capital's cultural tourism. In terms of application and review mechanisms, the Measures specify full-chain management from application, preliminary review, and re-review to public announcement and fund disbursement, ensuring standardized, transparent, and precise allocation of rewards. Applicants must have independent legal personality, no major violations in the past three years, and projects must have good economic and social benefits. It is reported that the Measures will continue to stimulate innovation vitality of travel agencies and cultural tourism enterprises by leveraging the guiding role of fiscal funds, fostering new business formats, models, and scenarios for cultural tourism consumption, and promoting the city's overall development.

headlines.title: 外交部回应美国实施先进机器人进口限制
headlines.summary: 针对美国联邦通信委员会宣布对外国制造的先进机器人实施进口限制，包括中方占有主导地位的人形机器人，外交部发言人毛宁7月29日在例行记者会上说，中方一贯坚决反对美方泛化国家安全概念打压中国企业。保护主义提升不了美国的竞争力，只会损害美国企业和消费者的利益。中方将继续采取必要措施，坚定维护中国企业的正当合法权益。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry responds to US advanced robot import restrictions
headlines.summary_en: In response to the US Federal Communications Commission's announcement of import restrictions on advanced robots made abroad, including humanoid robots where China plays a dominant role, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said at a regular press conference on July 29 that China consistently opposes the US overstretching the concept of national security to suppress Chinese companies. Protectionism will not enhance US competitiveness but will harm the interests of US companies and consumers. China will continue to take necessary measures to firmly safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese companies. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 获刑15年 国家发展改革委原党组成员、副主任徐宪平一审宣判
headlines.summary: 据央视，2026年7月29日，内蒙古自治区赤峰市中级人民法院一审公开宣判国家发展和改革委员会原党组成员、副主任徐宪平受贿一案，对被告人徐宪平以受贿罪判处有期徒刑十五年，并处罚金人民币五百万元；对徐宪平犯罪所得财物依法予以追缴，上缴国库。

headlines.title_en: Former NDRC official Xu Xianping sentenced to 15 years in first-instance trial
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, on July 29, 2026, the Intermediate People's Court of Chifeng City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, publicly sentenced Xu Xianping, former member of the Party Leadership Group and former deputy director of the National Development and Reform Commission, in a bribery case. The defendant Xu Xianping was sentenced to 15 years in prison for bribery and fined 5 million yuan. All criminal proceeds from Xu Xianping's crimes will be recovered and turned over to the national treasury.
